notes: All samples rifampicin time courses (0-20 min); no untreated control, is_control left out. transcription_arrested left out at 0 min. 'Mut' genotype not described: genotype labels left out. Signal-peptide fusion samples (neo, bla, mMaple3, phoA, lacZ): cDNA made with primers targeting the fusion barcode region, so assay_class other and genotype left out (construct not described). WTKas: kasugamycin 15 min before rifampicin, exposure short only for the 20 min samples (35 min of kasugamycin). Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.4 in LB (all samples <2 h after rifampicin). WT re-read: WT and WTKas samples set to wild_type.
